author: Axel Kaliff, KTH

author: CloudGripper-projektet

author: Shutong Jin, Axel Kaliff, Ruiyu Wang, Muhammad Zahid och Florian T. Pokorny
title: R900: Understanding the Cost-Effectiveness of Random Exploration from 900 Hours of Robotic Data Collection
note: DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.2503.23571. Används för datainsamling, episodhantering och återställning som designinspiration. Projektet reproducerar inte experimenten eller resultaten.

author: Cognibotics
title: Nowaste Logistics Advances Automation with Cognibotics Robot Picking Cell
kind: Manufacturer-reported second-cell order and first-cell production context
note: The 5 January 2026 release reports an ORDER for a second cell following the first pilot; it does not establish that the second cell was already installed. AutoStore, SICS AI vision and Juliet & Romeo roles are manufacturer descriptions, not an independently audited installation or proprietary interface specification.

author: Cognibotics
title: HKM1800 — robot for intralogistics and warehouse automation
note: Manufacturer-published reference envelope: 1.8 m radial reach over 360 degrees, approximately 10 square meters, close to 1 m Z stroke, tool rotation/change, 2 kg nominal and 7.5 kg maximum payload. These are attributed claims, not independent performance validation or simulator acceptance targets. No linked STEP/CAD model is downloaded or reused; synthetic envelope, six tools and geometry are independent design.

author: Cognibotics
title: Juliet & Romeo: Coexisting with Robotics and Automation Ecosystems
note: Beskriver samexistens med ROS 2, SRCI och IEC 61131. Visar möjliga gränssnitt, inte att alla används i en viss SICS-installation. Kompletterande läsning.

author: ENCCS
title: SICS AI: HPC Access to LUMI Supercomputer for AI and Robotics
note: Dokumenterar arbete med beräkningsmiljö och GPU-träning. Fastställer inte kundernas aktuella inferensarkitektur.

author: Aixia Group AB
title: SICS AI investerar i NVIDIA DGX B200 från Aixia
note: Bekräftar offentliggjord DGX B200-affär med drifttjänster. Inte ett test av modeller eller belägg för var dagens maskin är placerad.

title: MCP Server

author: SICS AI

author: Cognibotics
title: Hybrid Kinematic Machine (HKM)
note: Describes base-located drives and combined serial/parallel rod members. Used only for general visual inspiration. RobotOps uses original TCP-driven illustrative links, not reverse-engineered lengths, joint equations or controller parameters.

title: The fastest robot meets the fastest tool changer in new partnership
note: Supports tool changing as a use-case concept for varied items. The six RobotOps end-effectors, rack state machine, constraints and timings are independent SIMULATOR_DESIGN, not a claim that the supplier offers this exact tool set.

author: Nowaste Logistics
title: Revolutionerande AI-teknik testas hos Nowaste Logistics
note: Reports an HKM1800/SICS software production-environment pilot in Tostarp. Supports warehouse-picking use-case context only; no proprietary layout, throughput result, autonomy/AGI claim or internal architecture is imported into our design.

author: Florian T. Pokorny, KTH professor
title: Research homepage: Axel Kaliff thesis and CloudGripper-AutoGrasper publications
note: Lists Axel Kaliff and the simulation-in-the-loop thesis title, and first authorship of the CloudGripper-AutoGrasper IROS workshop work. This supports bibliographic provenance only. The thesis full text remains unreviewed; RobotOps does not reproduce its algorithm.

author: Blender Foundation
title: Blender Python API: Quickstart and Object transforms
note: Scripted objects, animation and scene data justify a fixed deterministic programmatic runtime. Primary quickstart was verified through the official search index; direct fetch failed. API capability is not robot-dynamics validation. Local runtime remains pinned/tested separately.

author: Bullet Physics maintainers
title: PyBullet Quickstart Guide
note: Documents articulated-body simulation, inverse kinematics and collision facilities. Scope comparison only: richer physics/IK might motivate another adapter later. PyBullet is not a RobotOps dependency and these capabilities do not validate the current Blender abstraction.

author: NVIDIA
title: Isaac Sim Motion Generation (Experimental)
note: The current API documents robotics motion-generation facilities and marks this interface experimental. Used to distinguish model-based robotics planning from RobotOps conservative synthetic preflight, not to imply an installed dependency or real-world safety guarantee.

author: NVIDIA
title: Isaac Sim Sensors
note: Robotics-oriented sensor simulation is a scope comparison. RobotOps observations come from an explicitly synthetic deterministic ObservationModel; rendering cameras does not implement computer vision.

author: Blender Foundation
title: Blender 5.2 command-line arguments: CPU scheduling and threads
note: Documents --qos for Windows hybrid CPUs and the rendering/operation thread option. The pinned Blender 5.2.1 executable's --help independently confirms these options. Selecting high QoS for the bounded child process is SIMULATOR_DESIGN, supported by local browser tests; it is not a real-time deadline or robot-performance guarantee.
